jobs.title: Platform & Product Manager
jobs.description:
Career Area:
Product Support
Job Description:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About The Opportunity:
The Manager, Platform & Product leads the multidisciplinary teams responsible for designing, developing, delivering and sustaining digital solutions that help customers achieve measurable performance improvements from MineStar.

The team owns the Productivity Solutions product portfolio, using automation, digitisation and AI across analytics, reporting, simulation and related capabilities to extend MineStar and improve customer outcomes globally. The team does not own the core MineStar products.

This role leads product ownership, engineering, architecture, business analysis and user experience capabilities across internal teams and external delivery partners.

You will set product and platform direction, prioritise and build a product-led operating model with clear accountability for customer value, delivery and the full product lifecycle.

What You Will Do:
- Lead the Product & Platform team, establishing clear direction, priorities, decision rights and accountability.

- Define and maintain product and platform strategies and roadmaps aligned with customer needs, MineStar capabilities and business objectives.

- Own the Productivity Solutions product portfolio across discovery, investment, delivery, adoption, sustainment and retirement.

- Prioritise investment and delivery by balancing customer value, strategic alignment, capacity, risk, technical health and long-term supportability.

- Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams across product, engineering, architecture, business analysis and user experience.

- Lead external delivery partners, managing outcomes, quality, cost and risk.
- Empower Product Owners and technical leaders to make timely decisions within clearly defined accountabilities and governance.

- Partner with MineStar product and technology teams to ensure solutions complement and integrate with core MineStar capabilities while avoiding unnecessary duplication.

- Manage cross-product dependencies, remove delivery barriers and escalate material risks and trade-offs.

- Ensure solutions meet agreed standards for scalability, reliability, security, data integrity, deployment readiness and supportability.

- Use customer insight, product data, field feedback and benefits evidence to guide priorities and continuous improvement.

- Partner across Data Engineering & Reporting, Product Adoption & Support,

- Content Development and other business and technology teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes.

- Build team capability through workforce planning, development, performance management and succession planning.

How Success Will Be Measured:
- Customer value: Priority products have agreed outcome measures and demonstrate verified customer or operational value against approved business cases.

- Roadmap delivery: Portfolio commitments are delivered predictably against approved scope, milestones, budget and quality expectations, with material variances actively managed.

- Product health: Products meet agreed reliability, security, performance, data quality and supportability expectations, with critical risks and technical debt reduced to plan.

- Portfolio value: Investment is regularly directed toward the highest-value opportunities, with clear remediation, consolidation or retirement decisions for underperforming or duplicative products.

- Stakeholder alignment: Product Owners, MineStar partners and dependent teams have clear priorities, decision rights and dependency plans, with unresolved issues escalated promptly.

- Team capability: Critical roles are filled, succession and development plans are active, and team engagement, performance and retention remain within agreed targets.

What Skills Will You Bring ?
- Leadership & People Development: Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and developing people, leaders and organisational capability.

- Product & Portfolio Leadership: Experience translating customer needs into product priorities and roadmaps, with the ability to make effective portfolio investment and lifecycle trade-offs.

- Customer & Performance Focus: Ability to connect product decisions to customer performance, operational outcomes and measurable business value.

- Technology Leadership: Broad understanding of software, cloud, data, digital platforms and architecture, with the ability to lead effectively through technical specialists.

- Change & Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience establishing product-led ways of working and aligning diverse teams around common priorities and outcomes.

- Decision Making & Communication: Ability to make clear decisions, manage competing priorities and communicate direction, risks and trade-offs effectively.

Qualifications & Experience:

- Required: Significant experience leading product, engineering, platform or digital technology teams in a complex enterprise environment.

- Required: Demonstrated experience leading Product Owners, people leaders, technical specialists and external delivery partners.

- Required: Experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps and making product lifecycle decisions.

- Required: Broad understanding of modern software, cloud, data, analytics, integration and architecture practices.

- Required: Experience delivering products that integrate with or extend enterprise technology platforms across globally distributed teams.

- Desirable: Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mining, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Desirable: Experience establishing or maturing product-led and platform-based operating models.

- Desirable: Mining, industrial technology, analytics or operational performance experience.

- Highly desirable: MineStar or comparable mine-site technology experience.

Additional Information:
-  This position requires the successful candidate to work full-time in our Redcliffe Perth office.
-  This position may require up to 25% travel.
-  Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Posting Dates:
October 1, 2026 - October 16, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Safety & Compliance)
jobs.description:
Career Area:
Technology, Digital and Data
Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Help Build the Future of Caterpillar
At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world—on real jobsites, at global scale.
You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations—over 1.6 million connected assets generating real-world data daily.  These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale.

Job Summary:
The Technical Product Manager - Safety & Regulatory Compliance is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and governance framework that enable autonomous, semi-autonomous, and remote-controlled construction machines to be developed, validated, deployed, and operated safely and in compliance with applicable regulatory and industry requirements. This role owns the product-level safety and compliance portfolio across the machine, autonomy system, remote-control system, supporting infrastructure, and operational environment, including safety requirements, functional safety, hazard and risk management, safety cases, regulatory readiness, compliance traceability, and certification support.
The role translates safety, regulatory, and operational risk into prioritized product capabilities and measurable acceptance criteria. It partners across Product Management, Technical Product Management, Systems Engineering, Functional Safety, Autonomy/Robotics, Machine Controls, Remote Operations, Cybersecurity, Validation, Quality, Legal/Regulatory, Architecture, and customer/site teams to ensure safety is engineered as an end-to-end system property rather than treated as a final compliance activity for autonomous and remote-controlled construction machines.
What You Will Do:
- Own and prioritize the Safety & Regulatory Compliance product backlog based on customer and business value, safety objectives, hazard severity, risk reduction, regulatory obligations, and program maturity.
- Define the safety and compliance product roadmap for autonomous, semi-autonomous, and remote-controlled construction machine capabilities from proof of concept through production deployment and lifecycle support.
- Partner with the Safety & Regulations division to translate applicable standards, regulations, corporate policies, safety analyses, and operational constraints into product requirements, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and release criteria for autonomous, semi-autonomous, and remote-controlled construction machines, while monitoring changes to applicable regulations and standard and assess product and roadmap impact.
- Lead product-level safety planning and cross-functional hazard identification/risk-management activities, including system hazard analyses, machine-control safety analyses, operational risk assessments, and mitigation planning.
- Partner with functional safety and engineering teams to define and maintain safety-related control functions, required performance levels, design constraints, verification expectations, and evidence needed to demonstrate that risk controls are implemented effectively.
- Drive end-to-end traceability from hazards and regulatory obligations through safety requirements, architecture/design controls, software and hardware implementation, verification and validation, residual risk, and objective compliance evidence.
- Define product-level safety readiness and compliance gates for demonstrations, pilots, releases, and production deployment, including clear go/no-go criteria, unresolved-risk disposition, exceptions, and escalation paths.
- Partner with Cybersecurity and Systems Engineering to ensure safety-relevant security threats, data/communications dependencies, software updates, and connected-system failure modes are considered in the overall safety argument.
- Build and maintain the product safety case/compliance evidence strategy and support audits, regulatory reviews, conformity assessments, certification activities, customer safety reviews, and deployment approvals.
- Establish and monitor safety and compliance KPIs, including open safety risks, mitigation closure, verification coverage, safety requirement traceability, compliance evidence completeness, audit findings, and release readiness.
- Communicate safety readiness, regulatory status, key risks, mitigation progress, certification milestones, and release constraints to technical teams, program leadership, customers, and other stakeholders.

What You Will Have:
Autonomy & Remote-Control Safety: Knowledge of safety principles for autonomous, semi-autonomous, and remote-controlled mobile machinery, including hazards introduced by machine decision-making, sensing/perception, localization, planning, control, communications, human-machine interaction, remote operator control, degraded operation, fallback, and safe-state behavior.
Functional Safety & Safety Engineering: Working knowledge of functional-safety concepts, safety-related control systems, hazard analysis, risk assessment, safety integrity/performance requirements, verification, validation, and safety-case development for complex electromechanical and software-intensive systems.
Regulatory & Standards Strategy: Ability to identify applicable regulations, standards, and market/site requirements; translate them into a product compliance strategy; manage applicability and interpretation with subject-matter experts; and maintain readiness as requirements evolve.
Systems Thinking & Requirements Management: Ability to decompose product-level safety outcomes into system/subsystem requirements and maintain bidirectional traceability across hazards, requirements, architecture, implementation, tests, and compliance evidence.
Risk Management: Ability to facilitate structured hazard identification, assess risk, prioritize mitigation, evaluate residual risk, and manage safety issues and change throughout the product lifecycle.
Product Management: Ability to build and prioritize roadmaps/backlogs, make tradeoffs, define measurable outcomes, manage dependencies, and balance product value, delivery needs, technical feasibility, safety, and compliance.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication: Ability to align engineering, safety, validation, legal/regulatory, operations, customers, and leadership around safety objectives, decisions, evidence, and release readiness without relying solely on direct authority.

Consideration For Top Candidates:
- 4+ years of experience spanning technical product management, autonomy/robotics, functional safety, systems engineering, machine controls, remote operations, safety engineering, regulatory compliance, or related technical leadership roles.
- Demonstrated experience leading safety and compliance strategy from concept and requirements through product roadmap execution, validation, deployment, and lifecycle support.
- Experience with autonomous or semi-autonomous mobile machinery and/or remote operator control systems in earth-moving, mining, construction, agriculture, industrial, automotive, or other safety-critical applications.
- Working knowledge of standards relevant to the product domain, such as ISO 17757 for autonomous/semi-autonomous earth-moving and mining machine systems, ISO 15817 for remote operator control systems, the ISO 19014 functional-safety series for earth-moving machinery, ISO 12100 risk assessment principles, and other applicable regional or machine-specific requirements.
- Experience facilitating or applying hazard analysis and risk assessment methods and converting identified risks into implementable safety requirements and validated mitigations.
- Experience with functional-safety concepts for safety-related control systems, including performance requirements, architecture/hardware/software considerations, diagnostics, fault response, and verification evidence.
- Experience defining safety requirements for behaviors such as emergency stop, controlled stop, obstacle/person detection, speed and motion limitations, geofencing/operating boundaries, control-mode transition, remote-control link loss, degraded operation, fallback, fault recovery, and safe-state behavior.
- Experience building or contributing to safety cases, compliance matrices, requirements-to-test traceability, regulatory submissions, audits, certification activities, or formal release-readiness reviews.
- Ability to work effectively with engineering, validation, functional safety, cybersecurity, legal/regulatory, quality, operations, customer/site teams, and senior leadership to resolve cross-domain safety issues and make risk-informed product decisions.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex safety and regulatory topics in product, engineering, executive, customer, and regulator-ready language.

Additional Details:
- This position requires the candidate to work full-time at the Irving, TX office (Dallas)
- Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position.
- Visa sponsorship is NOT available with this position.

Cat Digital is the digital and technology arm of Caterpillar Inc., leveraging the latest technologies to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers. With over 1.5 million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics, and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world.

Job Summary
The Product Owner, Digital Experience Platforms, is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, roadmap, and operational priorities for Caterpillar's digital experience platforms, including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS), and Vercel. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, platform engineering teams, architecture, security, and application teams to ensure the platforms deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing digital experiences.

The Product Owner will drive platform adoption, prioritize investments, manage platform backlogs, and ensure the platforms evolve to meet business and technical needs while aligning with enterprise objectives and digital transformation initiatives.

What You Will Do:
- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and governance for the AEM, Vercel, Akamai, and Enterprise Delivery Services (EDS) platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital experience goals, and enterprise architecture standards.
- Prioritize and manage the platform backlog, balancing business demand, platform enhancements, security requirements, technical debt, operational improvements, and modernization initiatives across all supported platforms.
- Drive platform reliability, performance, and security by overseeing Akamai CDN capabilities, web application security services, platform upgrades, incident management, vulnerability remediation, and service-level compliance.
- Partner with engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, marketing, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable digital solutions, improve author and developer experiences, and accelerate platform adoption through standardized best practices and governance.
- Manage vendor relationships, licensing, budget planning, and operational metrics for Adobe, Akamai, Vercel, and related partners while providing executive reporting on platform health, roadmap progress, risks, investments, and business value realization.

What you will have:
- Business Analysis: Knowledge of business analysis and the set of tasks, techniques and tools required to identify business needs; ability to recommend solutions that deliver value to stakeholders.
- Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
- Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
- Software Change Request Management: Knowledge of software change request management; ability to manage software product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff.
- Software Engineering: Knowledge of software engineering; ability to deliver new or enhanced fee-based software products.
- Software Problem Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for resolving software problems; ability to manage software problems in installed software products.
- Software Product Business Knowledge: Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; ability to manage install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.
- User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Knowledge of UAT activities, tasks, tools and techniques; ability to design, implement and evaluate acceptance tests for end-users.

Consideration for top candidates:
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field.
- Experience as Product Owner, Product Manager, or related experience within enterprise technology platforms.
- Experience managing digital experience, content management, or web application platforms.
- Strong experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Vercel Platform, Next.js Framework, CDN (Akamai) and Edge Computing technologies and AWS
- Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and product management practices.
- Preferred experience in Headless CMS architectures, Web Content Management Systems, Cloud Infrastructure and Hosting, Security and Compliance requirements, DevOps and CI/CD processes, Site Performance and Core Web Vitals, Digital Analytics and Monitoring

jobs.description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar's SPPD Digital Supply & Capacity Planning team is seeking a Senior Digital Product Owner to lead the development, adoption, and continuous improvement of VISTA (Visualized Insights: Supply Chain, Transportation, and Assets). VISTA is a critical enterprise digital product that enables strategic decision-making by visualizing material flows and key business measures at the part-number level, from external suppliers through Caterpillar facilities and ultimately to dealers.

In this role, you will serve as the product leader responsible for maximizing business value, prioritizing feature development, driving product adoption, and ensuring solution quality. You will make an impact in the areas of supply chain strategy, advanced analytics, software development, and business transformation. Working closely with supply chain leaders, data engineers, software developers, and analytics professionals, you will help shape digital capabilities that improve supply chain visibility, operational efficiency, and decision-making across the enterprise.

This position is ideal for candidates with deep product ownership experience, a strong quantitative mindset, and a passion for translating complex supply chain data into actionable business insights.

What you will do:

Digital Product Leadership
- Provide day-to-day leadership for the development, quality, adoption, and continuous improvement of the VISTA digital product.
- Define and maintain product vision, roadmap, priorities, and release strategies.
- Coordinate with business process owners to identify, evaluate, and prioritize development opportunities.
- Translate business challenges into actionable product requirements and user stories.

Software Product Management
- Lead the execution and tracking of product enhancements, maintenance releases, and defect remediation.
- Partner with software engineering teams to design, build, test, and deploy new capabilities.
- Manage software change requests and enhancement opportunities originating from business users and stakeholders.
- Monitor product performance, adoption metrics, and business outcomes.

Stakeholder Engagement & User Experience
- Gather, consolidate, and prioritize feedback from users and business partners.
- Serve as the primary product expert by creating product documentation, user guidance, and training materials.
- Partner with end users to understand evolving business needs and improve user adoption.
- Communicate product strategy, priorities, and progress to functional and leadership stakeholders.

Analytics & Supply Chain Solutions
- Collaborate with Digital Supply & Capacity Planning teams to integrate data, applications, and analytical insights.
- Support visualization and analysis of material flow, transportation, inventory, supplier, and asset-related data.
- Leverage quantitative and analytical approaches to improve decision-making capabilities.
- Partner with supply chain stakeholders to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions.

Product Quality & Governance
- Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution, and validation activities.
- Identify and resolve design, reliability, performance, and maintenance issues.
- Ensure solution quality through testing disciplines, release validation, and user feedback loops.
- Support governance processes related to software product lifecycle management.

What skills you will have:

- Software Engineering: Strong understanding of software development practices and the ability to partner effectively with development teams to deliver new capabilities and enhancements. In practice, this includes translating business needs into product requirements, prioritizing development work, guiding feature delivery, and ensuring solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with user expectations.
- Software Product Business Knowledge: Demonstrated ability to manage and evolve software products that deliver measurable business value. In this role, you will serve as the product owner for VISTA, defining product priorities, managing the product roadmap, understanding user needs, and ensuring the platform continues to support strategic supply chain decision-making. You should be comfortable balancing current business requirements with future product vision while driving adoption across multiple stakeholder groups.
- Business Analysis: Ability to identify business needs, evaluate opportunities, and recommend solutions that create value. In this role, you will work closely with supply chain process owners and business partners to gather requirements, analyze workflows, and translate complex operational challenges into digital solutions that improve visibility, planning effectiveness, and decision-making.
- Software Change Request Management: Experience managing feature requests, enhancement opportunities, and product improvements throughout the software lifecycle. Successful candidates will be skilled at evaluating competing priorities, balancing business impact against technical effort, and maintaining a transparent and value-driven product backlog.
- User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Ability to design, coordinate, and execute user acceptance testing activities to ensure products meet business requirements and user expectations. This role will lead testing efforts for new functionality, establish acceptance criteria, coordinate stakeholder participation, and validate successful deployment of product enhancements.
- Software Problem Management: Knowledge of tools, processes, and best practices for identifying, investigating, and resolving software issues. In this role, you will partner with users and development teams to troubleshoot problems, manage defect resolution, communicate status updates, and ensure product reliability and performance.

Top Candidates Will Also Have

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline; or an advanced degree with relevant experience.
- Experience applying quantitative, analytical, statistical, modeling, or operational research techniques to solve complex business problems and inform decision-making.
- Proven success leading or supporting digital products, analytics platforms, or software solutions within product ownership, product management, business analysis, or similar role.
- Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions and collaborate effectively with software developers, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
- Experience working with large, complex datasets and modern analytics technologies, including SQL, Python, Snowflake, data visualization tools, and data engineering concepts.
- Demonstrated ability to leverage data and insights to improve supply chain, logistics, transportation, inventory, manufacturing, or operational performance.
- Experience leading user adoption, gathering customer feedback, prioritizing enhancements, and driving continuous product improvement.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience with graph databases, supply chain analytics platforms, digital supply chain visibility tools, or advanced analytics technologies is preferred.

Additional information:

- Primary Work Location:  This role is based in Mossville, IL or Irving, TX and will require working onsite five days a week.
- Relocation:  Relocation assistance is not available.
- Travel:  This role may require occasional travel up to 10%.

jobs.title: Product Analytics Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Career Area:
Technology, Digital and Data
Job Description:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description
The Solutions Architect is the end-to-end technical owner of an enterprise analytics platform composed of a governed analytics function library, a visual workflow builder, an agentic AI analyst, and a tool/integration layer (e.g., Model Context Protocol servers) that grounds the agent in governed enterprise data.
This role owns architectural cohesion, non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, reliability, security, cost), code quality, and delivery across all platform surfaces, and integration with upstream and downstream enterprise systems. As the platform's agentic capabilities mature, the role is the AI Solutions Architect — designing, reviewing, and governing agent, retrieval, evaluation, and safety architecture in line with enterprise architecture, security, and Responsible AI standards.
What You Will Do
Solution & Platform Architecture
- Own the end-to-end architecture: data sources → analytics library → tool/integration layer → AI agent & workflow builder.
- Define scalable, secure, reusable patterns for APIs, agent tools, event flows, and platform extensions; govern API lifecycle (versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation, contract testing).
- Own non-functional requirements : latency budgets, throughput, availability/SLOs, capacity planning, and resilience (retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation, DR/BCP).
- Govern integrations with enterprise data sources (telemetry, service, warranty, parts, work orders) and ongoing data-warehouse migrations.
- Maintain the architecture roadmap, reference architectures, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) ; drive build-vs-buy and vendor/tooling evaluations; manage tech debt deliberately.

Data, Retrieval & Context Architecture
- Design the RAG / knowledge architecture : ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, retrieval quality, and freshness.
- Own the semantic layer, data contracts, and metadata/catalog that let the agent reliably map natural language to governed data.
- Define agent memory and context architecture (session state, short- vs long-term memory, context-window optimization, semantic caching).

AI & Agentic Architecture
- Architect the agent backbone: orchestration/planner-executor patterns, tool boundaries, memory, evaluation hooks, and guardrails; support multi-agent patterns as needed.
- Define the LLM provider strategy (cloud-hosted, self-hosted, model gateway) and a cost/FinOps architecture : model routing, caching, token economics, and budget guardrails.
- Own the LLMOps lifecycle architecture : model/prompt versioning and registries, canary/A-B rollout of prompts, model upgrade and deprecation strategy.
- Own the evaluation & observability architecture : LLM tracing (OpenTelemetry), trace stores, golden datasets, eval-in-CI, online/offline eval, drift and regression gates.
- Establish AI governance practices: design reviews, risk assessments, Responsible AI alignment, and lifecycle management of agents and prompts.

Security, Trust & Compliance
- Own the AI threat model : prompt injection, data exfiltration via tools, jailbreaks, output sanitization, and least-privilege tool authorization .
- Architect multi-tenancy, data scoping, row-level security, PII/DLP, and audit/traceability across data and prompts.
- Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, IT controls, confidential-data handling, and emerging AI regulatory requirements (e.g., AI Act, model cards, data residency).

Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership
- Lead sprint planning, code reviews, and technical design docs; set coding standards and release cadence.
- Stay hands-on 30–50%: build reference implementations, unblock complex tickets, prototype risky areas.
- Own end-to-end troubleshooting across all platform components and integration points.
- Mentor engineers on architecture principles, integration patterns, and AI solution design; contribute to hiring, interviewing, team topology, and onboarding/enablement .

Stakeholder Collaboration & Governance
- Serve as the trusted technical advisor to the PM, sponsor, AI Center of Excellence, enterprise IT, and security partners.
- Lead or participate in architecture review boards, design-governance forums, and change-impact assessments.
- Define and report architecture success metrics (reliability, latency, cost-per-insight, eval/accuracy, adoption readiness).
- Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade-offs to technical and business audiences.

What You Have
- Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; 8+ years building production software, with at least 3 years as a tech lead or solutions architect on a data, analytics, or AI platform.
- Application Design & Architecture: Converts business requirements into clean, modular, well-documented technical designs and reference architectures.
- System & Technology Integration: Deep knowledge of integrating heterogeneous applications, databases, and platforms, with disciplined API/contract governance.
- Systems & Reliability Engineering: Strong grounding in distributed systems, async patterns, scalability, observability, resilience, and secure-by-design.
- Technical Troubleshooting: Anticipates, diagnoses, and resolves complex multi-system issues — including non-deterministic AI failure modes — quickly.
- Technology Advising: Advises product, engineering, and senior leadership on technology trade-offs and risk.

Core Technical & Functional Skills
- Languages & Frameworks: Expert-level Python; working knowledge of TypeScript / Node.js for full-stack reviews.
- Cloud: Production experience on AWS and/or Azure (compute, storage, networking, IAM).
- Data Platforms: Cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks); strong SQL; data modeling; vector stores and retrieval .
- AI / Agentic: Hands-on with LLMs, agent frameworks (Model Context Protocol, function-calling, LangChain / LlamaIndex / Semantic Kernel / Agent SDKs), RAG, context/memory design , and evaluation harnesses.
- LLMOps & Observability: Model gateways, prompt/agent registries, LLM tracing, eval pipelines, drift detection.
- DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, containerization, IaC concepts.
- Security: Secure-by-design mindset; AI-specific threat modeling , authorization/least-privilege, and enterprise confidential-data handling.

What Will Set You Apart
- Experience designing or governing production AI agents, copilots, or AI-enabled enterprise applications at scale.
- Strong grasp of Responsible AI, model governance, ethical AI, and emerging AI regulation.
- Prior architecture role on a multi-tenant analytics platform or developer platform.
- FinOps for LLM/compute — optimizing cost-per-query and inference spend at scale.
- Experience integrating with industrial / engineering data ecosystems.
- Recognized open-source or internal-tools contributions and architecture thought leadership.pdated
